body:
Go application transitions previously reached the browser through dedicated WASM adapters. This adds a bounded staged compiler: pinned GoScript compiles the unchanged counter plus Go form, keyed-list and deterministic-effect fixtures into inspectable TypeScript/JavaScript. Generated Go forwarding functions preserve the value-call boundary; one generic React19.3.1 renderer/runtime invokes their emitted exports. This compiled path uses no WASM and no handwritten JavaScript application reducer.

Stacks on #10 at `42df6883337605d901a23e9fed874768c7ce1824`. All **602 changed paths are additions**; all1,228 predecessor tracked files and Milestone0’s24 receipt pins remain exact. No main merge or production deployment.

### Reproduce and inspect
```sh
bash run-compiled-frontend.sh
python3 -m http.server 8080
# Open /compiled-frontend/artifacts/demo/
```
Root Go1.24 and Node22 remain required; the isolated compiler downloads/uses pinned Go1.27.3. [README, dependencies, archive extraction and demo](https://github.com/samuelpmahan/gondola/blob/408e330517b1dd5e5f865e2ff1914465f98bcf66/compiled-frontend/README.md) · [Exact commands, executed results and limits](https://github.com/samuelpmahan/gondola/blob/408e330517b1dd5e5f865e2ff1914465f98bcf66/compiled-frontend/RESULTS.md) · [Closed contracts](https://github.com/samuelpmahan/gondola/blob/408e330517b1dd5e5f865e2ff1914465f98bcf66/compiled-frontend/CONTRACT.md) · [Final acceptance](https://github.com/samuelpmahan/gondola/blob/408e330517b1dd5e5f865e2ff1914465f98bcf66/compiled-frontend/coordination/final-acceptance.json).

### Executed local acceptance
- **Four apps / five scripts /43 ticks /zero mismatches** across native Go, independently replayed emitted JavaScript and mounted Chromium. **89 mutation controls** detect changed state/tree/bindings/messages/order/effects/DOM/selection. An independent capture and five independently rerun offline checkers confirm the same result.
- **81/81 Node tests**, Go1.24 current contracts/fixtures/native tests/race/vet and Go1.27.3 compiler/analyzer/build/CLI/emitter tests/race/vet pass. **116 source pins and209 generated output hashes/byte counts** match before/after. Outputs include186 emitted TypeScript files and5 forwarding Go-module inputs. CLI failure preserves all209 prior files while returning `ok:false`/exit1; malformed requests fail before the output transaction.
- The real HTTP demo smoke mounts all four components and exercises counter/reset disabled behavior, controlled text/checkbox save, literal `target.value`, keyed edit/reorder and pending DOM before one manual effect reply. [Actual screenshot](https://github.com/samuelpmahan/gondola/blob/408e330517b1dd5e5f865e2ff1914465f98bcf66/compiled-frontend/evidence/accepted/demo.png).
- Complete inherited runner passed: original **5,000 cases /seed20261030 /59 rules /24 SHA pins**, all intervening interaction gates, and final inherited **63 scripts /2,463 actions /4,926 actor/native comparisons /zero mismatches**, seeds20261030/20261031. Local validation used two completed commands: inherited runner, then `--compiled-only`; it is not described as a single default-command run.
- Exact executed309-file archive, source/artifact manifests, independent traces and historical failed bundles are preserved. Local tools: Go1.24.0/1.27.3, Node22.23.4, React/ReactDOM19.3.1, esbuild0.28.2, Playwright1.64.1, actual Chromium153.0.8010.0. Source tree `cd615e4bd0e83e31dd87232207afb2bf6416ccff` equals the locally reviewed commit `f7441435e5900efa17eb58c7285384dfe2787d29`; API commit metadata differs.

### Review and repaired boundaries
Six actual Luna6 XHigh workers used all six available child slots. Native Rebalancer1.0.4, pinned to current toolkit PR1, allocated disjoint author/repair/audit packets and independent reviews; **34/34 packets completed**,26 allocation epochs had no broken constraints, and receipt identity/independence verification passes. Native allocation/operator acknowledgement and actual platform dispatch are explicitly separate. [Coordination protocol and receipts](https://github.com/samuelpmahan/gondola/blob/408e330517b1dd5e5f865e2ff1914465f98bcf66/compiled-frontend/coordination/README.md).

Repairs include generated Go forwarding, event casing, effect markers/spec, completion/dispatch Proxy reentry, physically honest unmount snapshots, numeric guard invalidation and Number/BigInt codec agreement. Actual GoScript integration exposed private spare-zero metadata and unused slice-capacity holes; renderer and encoder now copy the visible window without executing its factory. A fifth script exercises growth at3/5 rows plus edits, checkbox, reorder, removal/reset. Initial amendments, failed runs, metadata corrections and explicit historical provenance gaps remain preserved.

### Guarantees and next milestone
This establishes finite serialized synchronous Chromium equivalence for the named fixtures: exact typed state (nil/empty and negative-zero bits), tree/bindings, requested intent versus actual messages/target values, dispatch/effect order, mounted outerHTML/live controlled properties, removed-node callback fencing, keyed identity/backward selection and commit-before-reply/exactly-once completion.

No universal Go/range-analysis or arbitrary library/initializer guarantee, second compiled backend, concurrent scheduling, IME, hydration, pixels, other engine, production transport or committed-state rollback. Float64Array-backed GoSlice wrappers and retained browser callbacks after runtime unmount remain untested. Another backend must consume the same AppIR/emitted Go symbols and satisfy the same renderer, lifecycle and conformance contracts. Next coherent capability: a second compiled DOM backend through this pipeline and oracle.

Fresh clean-checkout CI runs the full default command. Its results will be attributed to the actual published commit separately; no CI success is claimed by these local results.
